hero.title: Experience Pure Vegetarian Delights at Gramin
hero.subtitle: Savor authentic, wholesome vegetarian cuisine crafted with passion and the freshest ingredients, right here in Bengaluru. Gramin invites you to a culinary journey.

about.title: Welcome to Gramin: A Culinary Journey for the Senses
about.paragraph1: At Gramin, we believe in the power of pure, plant-based flavors to create unforgettable dining experiences. Our restaurant is a heartfelt celebration of authentic vegetarian cuisine, meticulously prepared to delight your senses and nourish your soul. We're dedicated to bringing you the true essence of wholesome dining.
about.paragraph2: From traditional recipes passed down through generations to innovative dishes crafted with a modern twist, Gramin offers a diverse menu that caters to every palate. We pride ourselves on using the freshest, locally sourced ingredients to ensure every meal is not just delicious, but also wholesome and truly satisfying. Come discover the Gramin difference.
